segments.2PE.1.3-4: God has given believers everything needed for godly life
segments.2PE.1.5-7: Peter urges believers to add good qualities to faith
segments.2PE.1.10-11: Peter urges believers to be sure of God’s calling
segments.2PE.1.12-15: Peter will keep reminding believers before he dies
segments.2PE.1.16-18: Peter and others saw Jesus’ majesty and heard God’s voice
segments.2PE.1.19-21: Prophecy in Scripture comes from God, not from men
segments.2PE.2.1-3: False teachers will secretly bring in destructive ideas
segments.2PE.2.4-6: God punished angels, the old world, and Sodom and Gomorrah
segments.2PE.2.7-9: God rescued Lot and knows how to rescue the godly
segments.2PE.2.10-11: False teachers who despise authority will be punished
segments.2PE.2.12-14: False teachers are like animals, full of greed and sin
segments.2PE.2.15-16: False teachers follow the way of Balaam
segments.2PE.2.17-19: False teachers promise freedom but are slaves to sin
segments.2PE.2.20-22: People who turn back from the truth end up worse off
segments.2PE.3.1-2: Peter writes a second letter to remind believers
segments.2PE.3.3-4: Scoffers will mock the promise that Jesus will come
segments.2PE.3.5-7: God’s word judged the world by flood and will judge by fire
segments.2PE.3.8-9: The Lord is patient because he wants all to repent
segments.2PE.3.10-10: The Day of the Lord will come like a thief
segments.2PE.3.11-13: Believers should live holy lives and wait for a new earth
segments.2PE.3.14-16: Peter urges believers to be at peace and blameless
segments.2PE.3.17-18: Peter warns believers to beware error and grow in grace
